blocks.text: 你惦惦 越頭飄撇的去

blocks.spelling: bô lí-iû khah-su m̄ bat lâi tàu-tīn

blocks.spelling: hue lī ki sī bē uì tó-uī khì

blocks.text: 只剩阮 知影心內的酸甘甜
blocks.spelling: tsí tshun gún tsai-iánn sim-lāi ê sng kam-tinn

blocks.spelling: hōo lo̍h-buē-thîng tī hit nî ê kuânn-thinn

blocks.spelling: bē lâi lī-khui sī tsuánn-iūnn ê sim-tsîng
